QuestionStmt.S: Water rises up to height 'x' in a capillary tube immersed vertically in water. When the whole arrangement is taken to a depth 'd' in a mine, the water level rises up to height Y. If R is the radius of the earth then the ratio Y : x is

Solution.S:
Capillary rise $h \propto \frac{1}{g}$. At depth $d$, $g' = g \left(1 - \frac{d}{R}\right)$.

$$\frac{Y}{x} = \frac{g}{g'} = \frac{g}{g(1 - d/R)} = \frac{R}{R - d}$$

Thus $Y : x = R : (R - d)$, which corresponds to option B.
